{"code":"# Let's inspect the duplicates and deduplication process
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Unique patient_ids:", df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Let's sort by patient_id and sample_seq to keep the highest sample_seq
df_sorted = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, True])
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='last')
print("Deduplicated rows:", len(df_dedup))

# Let's check if there are any -999 in biomarker_baseline in the deduplicated set
num_sentinels_dedup = (df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print("Number of -999 in deduplicated set:", num_sentinels_dedup)

# Let's calculate the mean baseline biomarker value excluding -999
df_valid_baseline = df_dedup[df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
mean_baseline = df_valid_baseline['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print("Mean baseline biomarker (deduplicated, excluding -999):", mean_baseline)
print("Number of patients in mean calculation:", len(df_valid_baseline))
"}
